From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference>

Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 08:27:42 -0500
Subject: Re: Cloudify - Order Form (v2) + DPA attached for review

Evelyn / Laura —

I reviewed the DPA and the redline in the Order Form. Summary and recommendation below (short):

1) Flow-down / Subcontracting (Section 4.3)- Current vendor text is broad. Recommend we require:
   - affirmative flow-down obligation to subcontractors to abide by the DPA terms;
   - 30-day prior written notice for adding new subcontractors who will access customer data;
   - a right to receive SOC2 + reasonable evidence on request (not ongoing access to systems).

2) Audit Right- Accept with scope limits: security/compliance only, performed during business hours, with at least 30 days’ notice, and subject to confidentiality and non-disruption terms. We should avoid unlimited audit rights.

3) Data residency / cross-border- Confirm where Cloudify will process Redwood customer data (they indicated EU region). If they plan to process outside EU, include standard SCCs or equivalent mechanism in DPA.

4) PO / Order Form- Once vendor confirms flow-downs and provides subcontractor list + SOC2, legal can clear and we can issue PO. Please get procurement to confirm the PO number when ready.

If Cloudify accepts the modifications above, I’m comfortable approving the MSA/Order Form from a legal perspective. I’ve prepared a redline (attached separately) that narrows vendor language and adds the audit carve-outs.

- Karthik
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
